*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the
social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council Meeting
of October 13, 2020, at 1:00 P.M. for closed session as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking
  Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at
  yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk aphillips@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the
  members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00
  A.M. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter.
  Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 A.M. and
  prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact
  the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

  2.  By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of the public can

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate

minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  October 13, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
October 13, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:01 p.m.
The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Padilla, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Members Dotson, and Morales.
City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEM. Mayor Butts
inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
Closed Session Item.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:03 p.m. for Closed Session Item
No. CS-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Padilla, and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members Dotson, and Morales.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
item on the Agendas.

Gil Mathieu, District 4, spoke concerning the Warrant Register.

  1
 October 13, 2020

  Bill (Last Name Unknown), spoke concerning Agenda Item No. SPH-2, request to set a
  public hearing to consider the adoption of a resolution to establish Short Term Rental
  Fees.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  October 9, 2020, in the amount of $3,223,334.51 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, and Morales.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council
  Member Padilla, that the Minutes for the City Council Meetings held on May 19, 2020,
  May 26, 2020, June 9, 2020, and June 16, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  101  PAYMENT OF INVOICES AUTHORIZED - CONSTANT ASSOCIATES. Staff
  report dated October 13, 2020, was presented recommending authorization to pay
  invoices submitted by Constant Associates for emergency COVID-19 services provided
  to support the Office of Emergency Services during the beginning stages of the COVID-
  19 pandemic.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that the City Council does hereby authorize payment in the amount of $46,207.75. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  142  RESOLUTION NO. 21-11 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-
  2021 TO TRANSFER FUNDS FOR THE AGREEMENT WITH HdL COREN &
  CONE. Staff report dated October 13, 2020, was presented recommending adoption of a
  resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Budget to transfer funds in the amount of
  $23,000 to the Finance Department to fund Agreement No. 21-003 with HdL Coren &
  Cone.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that Resolution No. 21-11 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2020-21 ANNUAL BUDGET

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  183  PAYMENT OF INVOICE NO. 0921 AUTHORIZED – MR. GUY BLACK. Staff
  report dated October 13, 2020, was presented recommending authorization to pay invoice
  No. 0921 submitted by Mr. Guy Black for services rendered at the Unity Rally Event
  held at the Forum on June 6, 2020.

  2
 October 13, 2020

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that the City Council does hereby authorize payment in the amount of $400. The motion
  was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  103.1  EXECUTION OF GRANT AGREEMENT OFFER WITH FEDERAL AVIATION
  ADMINISTRATION AUTHORIZED AND APPROVED. Staff report dated October
  13, 2020, was presented recommending authorization and approval to execute a Grant
  Agreement offer of $3,750,000 with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for the
  Airport Improvement Program.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Authorize and approve the execution of the Grant
  Agreement Offer; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 21-12 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2020/2021 ANNUAL BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  301  PUBLIC HEARING SET – ESTABLISHING SHORT TERM RENTAL FEES.
  Staff report dated October 13, 2020, was presented public hearing be set to consider the
  adoption of a resolution to establish Short Term Rental Fees.

  Mayor Butts ordered the public hearing set for October 27, 2020, at the hour of 2:00 p.m.

  301  PUBLIC HEARING SET – SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL
  YEAR 2020-2021 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN FOR THE RECEIPT OF CARES
  ACT ROUND 3 FUNDING FROM THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND
  URBAN DEVELOPMENT (HUD). Staff report dated October 13, 2020, was presented
  requesting that a public hearing be set to consider the approval of a substantial
  amendment to the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Annual Action Plan for the receipt of CARES
  Act Round 3 funding from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
  (HUD).

  Mayor Butts ordered the public hearing set for October 20, 2020, at the hour of 2:00 p.m.

  132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR; NAME OF
  ORGANIZATIONS REPRESENTING EMPLOYEES; SERVICE EMPLOYEES
  INTERNATIONAL  UNION  (SEIU);  INGLEWOOD  MANAGEMENT
  EMPLOYEES ORGANIZATION (IMEO); INGLEWOOD EXECUTIVE
  ORGANIZATION (IEO); INGLEWOOD POLICE OFFICERS ASSOCIATIONS
  (IPOA); INGLEWOOD POLICE MANAGEMENT ASSOCIATION (IPMA);
  INGLEWOOD POLICE CIVILIAN MANAGEMENT ASSOCIATION (IPCMA).
  Closed session – Confidential – Attorney/Client Privileged; Conference with Labor
  Negotiator Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6; Name of the Agency
  Negotiator: Jose O. Cortes, Human Resources Director; Name of Organizations
  Representing Employees: Service Employees International Union (SEIU); Inglewood
  Management Employee Organization (IMEO); Inglewood Executive Organization (IEO);
  Inglewood Police Officers Associations (IPOA); Inglewood Police Management
  Association (IPMA); Inglewood Police Civilian Management Association (IPCMA).

  Status provided by Jose Cortes, Human Resource Director; Discussion held; Direction
  given to staff.

  126  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. Yvonne Horton, Inglewood City Clerk encouraged
  residents to register and exercise their right to vote.

  3
 October 13, 2020

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not
  elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  Curtis (Last Name Unknown), commented he is experiencing issues with the Police
  Department.

  Speaker (Name Unknown), commented rental assistance is needed for the residents of
  Inglewood.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented he would like the City Council to support the bill for
  public safety. He also commented that cameras should be placed on all Police Officers.

  Rick Ford inquired why SPH-2 is being heard in the afternoon.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Eloy Morales, Sr., at the hour of 2:25 p.m.

  Approved this 11th day of May, 2021.
